summary: EUDA Health Holdings Limited, a British Virgin Islands-incorporated Nasdaq-listed foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K containing notice and proxy materials for an extraordinary general meeting (EGM) scheduled for October 30, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. Eastern U.S. Time. The EGM agenda includes a resolution to reclassify the company's authorized and issued no-par shares into Class A ordinary shares and up to 2,000,000 Class B ordinary shares, with insiders Tan Meng Dong and 8i Capital receiving Class B shares. No transaction, price, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed. The filing is a routine shareholder meeting notice, not a special situation; the risk-arb angle is limited to any future corporate events implied by the dual-class structure.
